adminCatalog.title: Catalog
adminCatalog.copy: Manage retained fixed-term plan terms and sparse overrides for upstream X-Node squads.
adminCatalog.noCombosHint: Configure fixed-term terms for grandfathered renewals and administrator grants.
adminCatalog.squadsHint: Identity comes from live X-Node squads; only non-default display and price values are stored locally.
adminCatalog.noSquadsHint: Refresh from X-Node to configure optional access.
adminCatalog.hideDescription: This plan will no longer be selectable for new administrator grants. Existing purchases and their renewal eligibility are retained.

adminCatalogEditor.name: Name
adminCatalogEditor.trafficLimitHint: Use bytes or B, KB, MB, GB, or TB. It is saved as exact bytes.
adminCatalogEditor.trafficLimitInvalid: Enter bytes or a value such as 10 GB.
adminCatalogEditor.noSquads: Refresh X-Node squads before assigning them.
adminCatalogEditor.liveTermsHint: Hiding prevents new administrator grants. Existing purchases keep their live plan reference and remain eligible for renewal.
adminCatalogEditor.invalidFields: Check the name, price, traffic, quotas and validity before saving.
